arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date) ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Counts online transactions in each month of 2019, in month order, using the same grouping as the earlier monthly count.
assumptions: 2019 covers the data from January through October 2019, since the data ends on 2019-10-31; months after October are absent.
